features.name: glucose_zscore_clipped
features.description: Clipped z-score of plasma glucose using the training-fold mean and standard deviation, with zero treated as an implausible entry and replaced by the fold mean before scaling.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies a normalized glycemic axis so the margin can use this high-scale measurement without scale dominance.

features.name: bmi_zscore_clipped
features.description: Clipped z-score of mass, the BMI column, using training-fold scaling and mean replacement for zero.
features.expected_model_benefit: Keeps adiposity contribution on a comparable numeric scale for a linear margin.

features.name: blood_pressure_zscore_clipped
features.description: Clipped z-score of diastolic blood pressure using training-fold scaling and mean replacement for zero.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds vascular stress information on the same scale as other normalized measurements.

features.name: age_zscore_clipped
features.description: Clipped z-score of age using training-fold scaling.
features.expected_model_benefit: Places aging effects on a smooth centered axis that is easy for a linear SVM to weight.

features.name: pedigree_zscore_clipped
features.description: Clipped z-score of diabetes pedigree function using training-fold scaling.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides heritable-disposition signal as a scaled continuous input.

features.name: insulin_glucose_log_ratio
features.description: Log-scaled insulin-to-glucose ratio after replacing impossible zero insulin or glucose entries with training-fold means.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures relative insulin response with reduced skew, giving the margin a compact metabolic balance feature.

features.name: skin_bmi_ratio_clipped
features.description: Skin-thickness-to-BMI ratio after replacing impossible zero skin or mass entries with training-fold means.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds body-composition shape information that is more scale-stable than either raw measure alone.

features.name: pregnancy_age_ratio_clipped
features.description: Pregnancy count divided by approximate post-puberty age exposure, clipped to a compact range.
features.expected_model_benefit: Represents reproductive-history exposure as an interaction-like continuous feature.

features.name: zero_measurement_fraction
features.description: Fraction of core physiological measurements recorded as zero among plas, pres, skin, insu, and mass.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives the margin a normalized artifact burden signal so impossible entries can be handled separately from physiology.

features.name: metabolic_linear_projection
features.description: Weighted projection of glucose, BMI, age, pedigree, and pressure z-scores using unsupervised training-fold scaling.
features.expected_model_benefit: Offers an approximate linear medical projection with balanced scales, useful for a single-margin learner.

features.name: cardiometabolic_pattern_judgment
features.description: Numeric assessor score from 0 to 1 reflecting how coherent the row appears as a cardiometabolic concern pattern when considering plas, mass, pres, age, pedi, preg, skin, and insu together; 0 denotes little concern pattern, 1 denotes strong concern pattern.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a monotone, domain-informed synthesis of cross-column context that a linear margin can use as one smooth axis.

features.name: measurement_quality_judgment
features.description: Numeric assessor score from 0 to 1 for credibility of row measurements based on impossible zeros and cross-checks such as insulin versus plasma glucose and skin thickness versus BMI; 0 denotes very questionable, 1 denotes highly credible.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps reduce the influence of artifacts by giving the margin a continuous reliability axis.
